Class DatabaseHandler

java.lang.Object
foodreview.DatabaseHandler
public class DatabaseHandler extends Object
This class consists exclusively of instance methods that are designed to directly interact with a MySQL database.

This is the main 'MODEL' of the Model-View-Controller architectural pattern. It is meant to handle all JDBC functionality within the Food Review System application. This means it's related to Review for objects and data, Category for Category enum variables and ReviewSystem for the user interaction and object instantiation.

The methods in this class utilize information from Review objects, taking the data from the objects and adding it to the database. It also returns, removes and updates Review data from the database. The class expects a valid server address, username and password when constructing an object. If a valid one isn't given, then it fails.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public boolean connect()
      Establishes a connection with a MySQL server, ensuring the required database and table exist.

      This method attempts to create a food_review_project database and a reviews table if they aren't already present in the server.

      Returns:
      true if the connection and/or setup were successful; false if any task failed and a SQLException occured.

    • idGenerator

      public int idGenerator()
      Generates the next free and unique ID from the database for a review.

      This method queries the reviews table for the highest existing ID and increments it by one to ensure the next review has a unique identifier.

      Returns:
      The next available int ID; -1 if the ID can't be generated or a SQLException occurs.

    • addReview

      public int addReview(Review r)
      Inserts a new record into the database using review data.

      This method takes data from the provided Review object and runs an INSERT statement on the table. It handles optional fields, checking for null values before insertion.

      Parameters:
      r - The Review object with the data to be stored.
      Returns:
      1 if the review was successfully added; {code 0} if it failed due to a {code SQLException}.

    • remReview

      public int remReview(int id)
      Deletes a record from the database at the given id.

      This method takes an int id and uses it to run DELETE query on the reviews table. This will remove the review from the database entirely.

      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the review to be deleted.
      Returns:
      1 if the review was successfully removed; {code 0} if it failed due to a {code SQLException}.

    • updateReview

      public int updateReview(int id, Review r)
      Updates a record with at the given id with the given review data.

      This method takes an int id and a Review object. An UPDATE query is then run on the record at the given id, replacing its information with the data in the Review object. This updates the record to reflect the new given information.

      Parameters:
      id - The id of the review to be updated.
      r - The Review object with the data to be stored.
      Returns:
      1 if the review was successfully updated; {code 0} if it failed due to a {code SQLException}

    • findReview

      public ArrayList<Review> findReview(String name)
      Searches the database for reviews that match the given name.

      This method performs a query on the reviews table, SELECT. It then constructs objects from the results, mapping the database types back to Java types, such as String and Category.

      Parameters:
      name - The name of the review(s) to search for.
      Returns:
      ArrayList of matching Review objects; null if no matches are found or a SQLException occurs.

    • getAverage

      public double getAverage(Category cat)
      Calculates the average rating for all reviews from a given category.

      This method performs a query SELECT ROUND(AVG) on the reviews in the database that match the given Category. The SQL Query gathers this information, averages it and reounds it to two decimal places. The method then takes this information and converts it into a decimal to be returned.

      Parameters:
      cat - The Category to filter the reviews by.
      Returns:
      The average rating as a double; -1.0 if there are no reviews in that category or a SQLException occurs.

    • getAll

      public ArrayList<Review> getAll()
      Gathers all reviews in the database, converted to Java datatypes.

      This method runs a SELECT query that returns all records in the database. Each record is then converted into its Java equivalent, including Category. They are all then put into an ArrayList to be returned.

      Returns:
      ArrayList of Review objects; null if there were no reviews in the database or an SQLException occurred.
